notes: Never-sleeps mission loop - the minimal closed loop of the autonomous-operations design (docs/design/autonomous_ops_design.md, car 1): set a goal, the service advances it while you sleep, reports go out through the configured bot at the tier you chose, and the mission only ever ends done or sealed-with-evidence. Constitution: SOUL.md gains a Mission conduct section - exhaust every method before calling a blocker done, never abandon mid-mission (DONE or SEALED-with-evidence are the only terminal states), never ask mid-mission (no questions, no waiting inside a mission turn; a missing capability becomes a declared fallback and a gap in the next report), honest reporting with bad news first, capability honesty carried over from hard constitution 9, and escalation narrowed to paid/authorized/decision items that suspends one subtask without stopping the others. Engine: mycore/mission.py - five-state machine (planned/running/paused_user/done/sealed) over an atomically-written registry, one mission at a time with a serial subtask queue, each slice one run_turn over an append-only event stream, and three budget tripwires (max_slices, max_wall_hours, max_daily_model_calls) that auto-seal with evidence and report - never a silent stop. Reporting: mission.reporting in all/milestones/final (default milestones) with per-tier minimum intervals (120s/900s/unlimited), same-window merge, decision and final traffic exempt from throttling, and delivery reusing the cron four-level fallback (origin, route, WD_CHAT slot, log-only) - no channel never stalls the mission. Capability manifest (tools-off set, enabled channels, credential slot presence by name only, web3 block) is captured at start and injected into every slice prompt together with the no-one-to-answer declaration; the report exit scrubs tokens and paths. Console: Settings gains a MISSIONS card - goal input, the three-tier selector, start/pause/resume/stop against live mission state, and a recent list; 26 new mission.* locale keys (packs 536 to 562). Verification: new tmp/e2e_mission.py leg 54/54 - goal start with 409 on double start, a real slice against a stub model endpoint with the event stream on disk, one report per tier in the arrow format, the done report with its four sections, stop sealing with evidence, budget tripwire sealing, constitution and no-one-to-answer injection asserted on the wire, sentinel zero-leak, production byte identity.
